query: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT e.all_tools AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_tools scope WHERE scope.endpoint_id=e.id AND scope.source_id=$2 AND scope.upstream_name=$3) THEN 'block' ELSE COALESCE(p.action,$4) END AS "action!: Action" FROM endpoints e LEFT JOIN tool_policies p ON p.endpoint_id=e.id AND p.source_id=$2 AND p.upstream_name=$3 WHERE e.id=$1
